experiments.name: reset-chain measurement
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 65535; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -65536; li.d $r6, 65535
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 65535; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -65536; li.d $r6, 65535' --asm 'vmod.hu $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.hu $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element-0 reset chain; the closure latency is cancelled by the calibration experiment.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 65535; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -65536; li.d $r6, 65535
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 65535; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.h $vr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -65536; li.d $r6, 65535' --asm 'vadd.b $vr0, $vr0, $vr2; vpickve2gr.hu $r4, $vr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; vreplgr2vr.h $vr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Measured over 8 operand pairs; min 16 cycles at 0/1, max 48 cycles at 65535/1. The sample experiment uses the max-latency pair. Latency is derived by subtracting the same closure around vadd.b (calibration experiment).
